completion_layers.rule: Qualified inputs, current states, operation occurrences, specimen lineage, full acquisition schedules, matched controls and safe closure
Report actual values, uncertainties and difference from literature; do not require historical efficiencies for procedural completion
All required branches and control packages satisfy their scoped requirements; one selected route is insufficient

predicates.rule: Every action-dependent unknown is resolved by a current qualified card; unresolved raw-data availability only blocks historical replay, not new qualified acquisition
Exactly nine distinct accepted section identities, each with ordered eleven local design slots, matching intended face and current assembly version
Separate successful build and safe thermal/motion release evidence before extraction
Every explicit point has four distinct valid raw records with matching pose/configuration/calibration/phase; clipped/missing attempts do not count
Only registered complex sample-minus-blank reflection fields with equal condition signatures and complete coverage
Post-run drift passes qualified bounds before closing validity
Correct evidence type, independent jobs and convergence; no physical branch dependency for numerical comparisons
Four probes times two independent termination jobs and nonsingular conditioned inversion at each frequency
Complete declared 50-restart ledger per cell, 1500-generation baseline unless logged failure; no baseline crossover
Incident-normalized normal flux, transmitted-direction share, pressure magnitude and theory bound never conflated

Archive failed/successful attempts, raw parents and custody. Enforce safe-state/cleanup only for used stations: fabrication-safe release, guide output-off/park, and closing drift only when field measurement was selected.

allow_alternative_routes: Accept equivalent valid partial orders satisfying dependency predicates, not one fixed reference action string
implementation: Executable static validators and adversarial synthetic unit tests only; no trustworthy runtime evaluator exists
